title: Token Atomizer Pricing Card Workbench
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Design a compact, reusable "token atomizer" pricing card that surfaces per-invocation and per-token costs, attribution metadata, and export controls for the Redwood Console Cost dashboard. The workbench should demonstrate how pricing tiers, SKU overrides, and cache/batching adjustments affect unit economics in real-time prototypes. Scope: (1) Single-card detail view (cost breakdown, contribution by prompt segment, model variant mapping), (2) Multi-card tiling for session-level aggregation, (3) CSV/JSON export affordances and permission gating, (4) Edge cases for batched vs streaming calls and fallback model inference. Acceptance criteria: visual spec + interactive Figma prototype, annotated accessibility checks (color contrast, keyboard focus), Handoff-ready tokens for engineering (specs, spacing, breakpoints), a brief usability test report with at least 6 participants and prioritized findings.
success_metrics:
- Reduce org-level time to interpret per-invocation cost from >5m to <90s (measured in lab tasks)
- Prototype shows stable mapping for 95% of common prompts (per internal eval harness)
- Clear export flow with permission-aware controls: ability to download top-level CSV for 90% of use cases
design_decisions:
- Use a vertically stacked card with an expandable detail rail to avoid nested modals for quick comparisons.
- Show a small sparkline of token distribution + primary cost contributors (model, compute, cache hits) as first-class micro-visuals.
- Pricing presets appear as compact pills that mutate the card preview (eg. 'Quantized', 'High-throughput', 'Premium SLO') rather than separate pages.
- Exports default to CSV with an option for long-form JSON export for analysis pipelines.
- Permission gating: only roles with billing-export permission see the full invocation list and can export.
- Accessibility: color palette avoids red/green-only indicators and uses labels with icons for colorblind users.
tradeoffs_and_risks:
- Compact cards reduce vertical space but limit space for long attribution strings; mitigation: inline truncation + hover flyout for full attribution.
- Realtime mutation of cost from pricing presets may create false expectations vs. actual billed amounts; mitigation: sticky disclaimer + link to ratecard.
- Showing model variant names may leak internal naming; mitigation: map to customer-facing aliases in UI layer.
